transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Doctor. Thank you so much for fitting me in, I really appreciate it. Um, I came in because... well, it's probably nothing too serious, I hope. But my mind just keeps going blank at, like, the worst possible times. 

I work as a flagger and a crossing guard, and lately I'll just... I'll look at the road-closure forms, or even just hold my stop-slow paddle, and suddenly I cannot remember the steps. And I've done this for years, so it's really embarrassing to even admit that I'm struggling with it. I feel awful about it, honestly, like I'm not doing a good job. 

Does that make sense? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information to start with.
Aside from feeling upset about these memory lapses, have you been feeling consistently down or depressed lately?

Well... I guess I have been a little down. It's probably just stress from work, honestly, I don't want to make a big deal out of it. But, um, yeah, I suppose it's been pretty consistent. 

Most mornings, I wake up with this... this heavy, hollow sadness right in my chest. It just feels like the day is already ruined before I even put my feet on the floor. It's silly, I know, I should be more positive, and I really try to be! I try to push through it. I hope that's the kind of thing you were asking about? I just want to make sure I'm answering your questions right.
About how long have you been experiencing this heavy sadness?

Well, um... it's been a while, I suppose. I mean, I really don't want to sound like I'm complaining or making excuses for myself. But, um... if I'm being completely honest, that heavy feeling, and just... feeling so guilty all the time, having no energy, and not really wanting to eat... it's been going on for about a year and two months now. 

I know that sounds like a long time to let it go on without fixing it, and I really have been trying to snap out of it, I promise. I just... I haven't been able to. Does that help? I hope I'm not overcomplicating things for you.
Before this past year and two months, had you ever experienced another period in your life where you felt this depressed or down?

No, no, I really don't think so. I mean, I've always tried to be a pretty upbeat person, you know? I've had normal bad days here and there, like anyone else, but never... never anything like this where it just won't go away. 

Before last year, I was always able to just put a smile on and get my job done. I really pride myself on being reliable. So this is... this is all pretty new for me. I hope that's okay, that I don't have a history of it before now? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right picture.
Have you ever experienced a period where you felt unusually high, hyperactive, or full of energy, needing very little sleep?

Oh, um... no, I really don't think so. I've never been the hyperactive type, to be honest. I mean, standing on my feet all day directing traffic, I definitely need my sleep at night just to function, you know? 

So, no, I haven't ever had a time where I felt unusually high or full of energy like that. I usually just try to stay steady and do a good job. I hope it's okay to say no to that one? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the answers you need to figure this out. Is that alright?
